page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with notes in the right margin. Above the title, a printed ornament with the page number (I). Foot: signature "A" at left and catchword "Ca-" below the last line.

main_text.head: INTRODUCTIO In Historiam Universalem.
main_text.p: HIstoria universalis tradit Imperiorum omnis ævi res maximas,Historia Universalis describitur.
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: Historia est vel Universalis vel Particularis.Dividi-tur (1.) in uni-versa-lem &
Universalis complectitur maximas Imperiorum Res ab Orbe condito, secundum certam temporum seriem, ad nostram usq; ætatem.&
Particularis singularum gentium nationumq;, vel alicujus tantùm ævi res complectitur.particu-larem,

page.notes: The printed page has a large woodcut-style initial H in "Historia", joined to the first word. The right margin notes are split across lines with printed hyphens kept where present. The note "Univer salis" has no printed hyphen after "Univer", so it is written whole. The "&" beside "lem" is a printed mark, kept as is. Faint show-through from the reverse side is visible at the margins and was left out. No running head is printed, as the page opens the work.
